compressionRate.question: How much can I compress a PDF?
compressionRate.answer: Typically 50-90% reduction depending on the quality level you choose.

textReadability.question: Will compression affect text readability?
textReadability.answer: No. Text remains perfectly readable. Only images are compressed.

compressPdfFiles.question: How to compress PDF files online
compressPdfFiles.answer: Upload your PDF file, choose a compression level (Low, Medium, or High quality), and click "Compress PDF". The process takes 5-15 seconds and your compressed file will download automatically. Files are automatically deleted within one hour, most immediately after processing.

differentCompressionLevels.question: What are the different compression levels?
differentCompressionLevels.answer: BlendPDF offers three levels: Low Quality (80-90% reduction, ideal for screen viewing), Medium Quality (60-70% reduction, balanced for most uses), and High Quality (40-50% reduction, maintains near-original quality for printing).

compressionReducePdf.question: Will compression reduce PDF quality?
compressionReducePdf.answer: Text quality is never reduced as it uses lossless compression. Image quality depends on the compression level chosen. Low quality compresses images more aggressively, while high quality maintains image clarity.

reducePdfFile.question: How much can I reduce PDF file size?
reducePdfFile.answer: File size reduction depends on content and compression level. Typical reductions are: Low Quality 80-90%, Medium Quality 60-70%, High Quality 40-50%. Documents with many images see the greatest reduction.

imagesCompressedPdfs.question: How are images compressed in PDFs?
imagesCompressedPdfs.answer: Images are compressed using lossy compression algorithms that reduce file size while maintaining acceptable quality. The compression level determines how aggressively images are compressed. Higher quality levels preserve more image detail.

compressionArabicPdfs.question: Does compression work with Arabic PDFs?
compressionArabicPdfs.answer: Yes, BlendPDF works perfectly with Arabic PDFs and all RTL languages. Text quality is preserved, and formatting, character order, and text direction are maintained exactly as in the original document.

fileSizeLimits.question: What are the file size limits?
fileSizeLimits.answer: You can upload PDF files up to 50MB in size. There's no limit on the compressed file size you can download. Very large documents may take longer to process.

compression.question: How long does compression take?
compression.answer: Compression typically takes 5-15 seconds for most files. Larger files with many images may take 20-30 seconds. Processing speed depends on file size, page count, and compression level selected.

originalFileModified.question: Is my original file modified?
originalFileModified.answer: No, your original file is never modified. BlendPDF creates a new compressed version while leaving your original file completely untouched on your device. You can keep both versions.

compressPasswordProtected.question: Can I compress password-protected PDFs?
compressPasswordProtected.answer: Currently, password-protected PDFs cannot be compressed. You'll need to unlock the PDF first using an unlock tool, then compress it. Support for protected PDFs may be added in future updates.

compressPdfsMobile.question: Can I compress PDFs on mobile devices?
compressPdfsMobile.answer: Yes, BlendPDF works seamlessly on smartphones and tablets. The interface is mobile-optimized with touch-friendly controls. Compression speed is the same as on desktop since processing happens on our servers.

pdfCompressionFree.question: Is PDF compression free?
pdfCompressionFree.answer: Yes, compressing PDFs with BlendPDF is completely free — no fees, no watermarks, and no premium tiers today. All compression levels and features are available at no charge.

filesCompression.question: What happens to my files after compression?
filesCompression.answer: All uploaded files are automatically deleted from our servers within one hour, most immediately after processing. We never read, store, or share the contents of your documents. No permanent storage is maintained.

compressionFailsProduces.question: What if compression fails or produces errors?
compressionFailsProduces.answer: Common issues include file size limits (max 50MB), corrupted PDFs, or network problems. Try refreshing and retrying. If problems persist, verify your file opens correctly in a PDF viewer and check your internet connection.

howItWorks.question: How does PDF password protection work?
howItWorks.answer: We encrypt your PDF using AES-256 encryption. When someone tries to open the PDF, they'll be prompted to enter the password you set. Without the password, the PDF cannot be opened.

passwordStrength.question: What makes a strong password?
passwordStrength.answer: Use a combination of uppercase and lowercase letters, numbers, and special characters. Avoid common words or personal information. The longer the password, the more secure it is.

removePassword.question: Can I remove the password later?
removePassword.answer: Yes, you can use our Unlock PDF tool to remove the password if you know it. Simply upload the protected PDF and enter the password to unlock it.

forgotPassword.question: What if I forget the password?
forgotPassword.answer: Unfortunately, if you forget the password, there's no way to recover it. The encryption is designed to be secure, so we cannot access your PDF without the password. Make sure to save your password in a secure place.

passwordProtectPdf.question: How do I password protect a PDF online?
passwordProtectPdf.answer: Upload your PDF (up to 50MB), type the password you want to use, and click "Protect PDF". BlendPDF encrypts the file with AES-256 and gives you a protected copy to download. No account or email is required.

encryptionBlendpdfProtect.question: What encryption does BlendPDF use to protect PDFs?
encryptionBlendpdfProtect.answer: BlendPDF encrypts your PDF with AES-256, the strongest encryption level defined in the PDF standard, using the qpdf engine. The password you set is required to open the file in any PDF viewer.

safeProtectPdf.question: Is it safe to protect a PDF online?
safeProtectPdf.answer: Yes. Uploads travel over an encrypted HTTPS connection, your password is used once to encrypt the file and is never stored, and files are deleted from our servers within one hour, most immediately after processing. We never read, store, or share document contents. We only collect aggregate, anonymous usage analytics.

protectingPdfFree.question: Is protecting a PDF free? Is there a watermark?
protectingPdfFree.answer: Yes, it is completely free. There is no watermark, no page limit, no daily quota that pushes you to a paid plan, and no premium tier. The protected file you download is your document, unchanged except for the encryption.

accountEmailAddress.question: Do I need an account or email address?
accountEmailAddress.answer: No. You can protect a PDF without creating an account or entering an email address. An optional email-delivery feature exists if you want the file sent to your inbox, but downloading directly never requires an email.

protectPdfAlready.question: Can I protect a PDF that already has a password?
protectPdfAlready.answer: No. If the PDF is already encrypted, the tool returns an error asking you to unlock it first. Use the Unlock PDF tool with the current password, then protect the unlocked file with your new password.

stopPeoplePrinting.question: Does this stop people from printing or copying my PDF?
stopPeoplePrinting.answer: Not separately. BlendPDF sets an open password: nobody can open the file without it. It does not currently offer print-only or copy-only restrictions, and anyone who knows the password can use the document normally once it is open.

fileSizeLimits.question: What are the file size limits?
fileSizeLimits.answer: One PDF per operation, up to 50MB. If your file is larger, run it through the Compress PDF tool first and then protect the compressed copy.

protectingPdfChange.question: Will protecting the PDF change its content or quality?
protectingPdfChange.answer: No. Encryption wraps the existing content without re-rendering it. Text, images, fonts, links, and layout are unchanged, and the file size stays roughly the same.

passwordProtectedPdf.question: Can a password-protected PDF be opened on any device?
passwordProtectedPdf.answer: Any reasonably modern PDF viewer can open AES-256 protected files, including Adobe Acrobat Reader, macOS Preview, Chrome, Edge, Firefox, and the standard iOS and Android viewers. Only very old software from before roughly 2010 may fail to open AES-256 files.

blendpdfCompareProtecting.question: How does BlendPDF compare to protecting a PDF in Adobe Acrobat or Word?
blendpdfCompareProtecting.answer: The encryption result is equivalent: all three can produce AES-256 protected PDFs. Adobe Acrobat Pro requires a paid subscription and offers extra permission controls; Word can only protect documents it exports itself. BlendPDF is free, works on any existing PDF, and needs no installation or account.

error.question: What should I do if I get an error?
error.answer: Check that the file is a valid PDF under 50MB and not already encrypted. If you see a "too many requests" message, wait a few minutes; protection is limited to 20 files per 15 minutes per user. If a valid file still fails, it may be corrupted; try the Repair PDF tool first.

howItWorks.question: How does adding page numbers work?
howItWorks.answer: We add page numbers to each page of your PDF at the position you choose. The numbers are embedded directly into the PDF, so they'll always be visible when the file is opened.

position.question: Where can I place page numbers?
position.answer: You can place page numbers at the top or bottom of pages, and align them to the left, center, or right. Choose the position that works best for your document.

format.question: What page number formats are available?
format.answer: You can choose from simple numbers (1, 2, 3), numbers with total (1 / 10), 'Page 1' format, or 'Page 1 of 10' format.

startFrom.question: Can I start numbering from a different number?
startFrom.answer: Yes! You can set the starting page number. For example, if you want to start from page 5, set 'Start From' to 5, and the first page will be numbered as 5.

addPageNumbers.question: How do I add page numbers to a PDF online?
addPageNumbers.answer: Upload your PDF (up to 50MB), pick one of six positions, choose a number format, set the starting number and font size, then click Add Page Numbers and download the numbered copy. The live preview shows the placement before you commit. No account or email is required.

skipCoverPage.question: Can I skip the cover page or number only some pages?
skipCoverPage.answer: Not directly — numbers are applied to every page. Workaround: use the Split PDF tool to separate the cover from the body, add numbers to the body (starting at whatever value you need), then merge the parts back together with the Merge PDF tool.

pdfAlreadyPage.question: What if my PDF already has page numbers?
pdfAlreadyPage.answer: The tool does not detect or remove existing numbering — it draws new numbers on top. If your document already has numbers at bottom-center, either place the new ones in a different position, such as a top corner, or remove the old numbering at the source and re-export before numbering.

arabicIndicNumerals.question: Can I use Arabic-Indic numerals or Arabic text in page numbers?
arabicIndicNumerals.answer: Not yet. Page numbers currently use Western digits (1, 2, 3) and English labels ("Page") in Latin script only. Arabic text support is coming. PDFs whose content is in Arabic number fine — the limitation applies only to the added label, not to your document.

safeUploadDocument.question: Is it safe to upload my document?
safeUploadDocument.answer: Yes. Files travel over an encrypted HTTPS connection and are deleted from our servers within one hour, most immediately after processing. We never read, store, or share document contents, and no account is needed. We collect only aggregate, anonymous usage analytics via Google Analytics — never your documents.

addPageNumbersPassword.question: Can I add page numbers to a password-protected PDF?
addPageNumbersPassword.answer: No. The tool detects encrypted PDFs and returns a clear error. Remove the password first with the Unlock PDF tool (you need to know the password), add the numbers, then re-protect the file with the Protect PDF tool if needed.

scannedPdfs.question: Does it work on scanned PDFs?
scannedPdfs.answer: Yes. The number is drawn on top of each page, and a scanned page is just an image, so numbering works exactly as it does for regular PDFs. No OCR is involved or needed for numbering. If you also want the scanned text itself to become searchable, run the file through the BlendPDF OCR tool.

fileSizeLimits.question: What are the file size limits?
fileSizeLimits.answer: One PDF per operation, up to 50MB, and up to 20 files per 15 minutes per user. There is no page-count limit. If your file is over 50MB, compress it first with the Compress PDF tool.

compareAddingPage.question: How does this compare to adding page numbers in Word or Adobe Acrobat?
compareAddingPage.answer: Word numbers documents it edits, but converting an existing PDF into Word often breaks the layout. Acrobat Pro has a flexible header/footer tool but requires a paid subscription. BlendPDF numbers any existing PDF without altering its layout, free, in the browser, with no account.

error.question: What should I do if I get an error?
error.answer: Check that the file is a valid PDF under 50MB and not password-protected (unlock it first if it is). A "too many requests" message means you hit the 20-files-per-15-minutes limit — wait a few minutes. If a valid file still fails, it may be corrupted; run it through the Repair PDF tool first.

howItWorks.question: How does watermarking work?
howItWorks.answer: We embed the watermark directly into your PDF. Text watermarks are added as text overlays, while image watermarks are embedded as images. The watermark becomes part of the PDF file.

textVsImage.question: What's the difference between text and image watermarks?
textVsImage.answer: Text watermarks are simple text overlays (like 'DRAFT' or 'CONFIDENTIAL'). Image watermarks use an image file (PNG or JPEG) that you upload. Both can be positioned and adjusted for opacity.

position.question: What position options are available?
position.answer: You can place watermarks in the center, diagonally across the page, or in a tiled pattern that repeats across the entire document.

removeWatermark.question: Can I remove a watermark later?
removeWatermark.answer: Once a watermark is embedded in a PDF, it becomes part of the file. To remove it, you would need to use a PDF editor or recreate the PDF without the watermark.

addingWatermarkPdf.question: How does adding a watermark to a PDF work?
addingWatermarkPdf.answer: BlendPDF draws your watermark directly into the content of every page. Text watermarks are rendered in bold gray type at the size and opacity you choose; image watermarks embed a PNG or JPEG you upload. The watermark becomes part of the PDF itself, so it shows up in every viewer and in print.

addWatermarkPdf.question: How do I add a watermark to a PDF online?
addWatermarkPdf.answer: Upload your PDF (up to 50MB), choose text or image mode, type the text or upload a PNG/JPEG, pick a position (center, diagonal, or tiled), adjust opacity and size while watching the live preview, then click to apply and download the watermarked copy. No account or email is required.

watermarkToolFree.question: Is the watermark tool free? Does BlendPDF add its own branding?
watermarkToolFree.answer: Yes, it is completely free, and no, BlendPDF never adds its own watermark or branding. The only watermark on the output is the one you chose. There are no page limits, daily quotas, or premium tiers.

watermarkPositionsAvailable.question: What watermark positions are available?
watermarkPositionsAvailable.answer: Three: center (horizontal, middle of the page), diagonal (rotated 45 degrees across the middle — the classic DRAFT look), and tiled (repeated in a grid across the whole page, which is the hardest to crop out). The same position is applied to every page.

controlOpacitySize.question: Can I control the opacity and size of the watermark?
controlOpacitySize.answer: Yes. Opacity runs from 10% to 100% (30% is the default and works well for labels that should not obscure content). Text size is adjustable from 12 to 120 points. A live preview shows the effect on your actual first page before you commit.

arabicNonLatin.question: Can I use Arabic or other non-Latin text in a watermark?
arabicNonLatin.answer: Yes. Type Arabic, Hebrew, Chinese, or any other script directly into the text field and it just works — the watermark is shaped and rendered right in your browser, with correct Arabic letter joining and right-to-left direction, then stamped onto every page. No workaround needed.

watermarkAppearEvery.question: Does the watermark appear on every page?
watermarkAppearEvery.answer: Yes, the watermark is applied to all pages of the document. There is currently no option to watermark only a page range. If you need that, split the PDF first, watermark the part that needs it, and merge the parts back together with our Split and Merge tools.

watermarkRemovedLater.question: Can a watermark be removed later? Does it protect my document?
watermarkRemovedLater.answer: Be realistic: a watermark deters casual misuse but is not security. It becomes part of the page content and cannot be removed in a viewer, but someone with a PDF editor and time can remove it — especially a single centered mark. Tiled watermarks at moderate opacity are harder to clean. For actual protection, use the Protect PDF tool, which encrypts the file with AES-256.

safeWatermarkConfidential.question: Is it safe to watermark confidential documents online?
safeWatermarkConfidential.answer: Yes. Files travel over an encrypted HTTPS connection and are deleted from our servers within one hour, most immediately after processing. We never read, store, or share document contents, and no account is needed. We collect only aggregate, anonymous usage analytics via Google Analytics — never your documents.

watermarkPasswordProtected.question: Can I watermark a password-protected PDF?
watermarkPasswordProtected.answer: No — remove the password first using the Unlock PDF tool (you need to know the password), apply the watermark, then re-protect the file with the Protect PDF tool if you want it encrypted again.

watermarkingScannedPdfs.question: Does watermarking work on scanned PDFs?
watermarkingScannedPdfs.answer: Yes, and it works well. The watermark is drawn on top of each page, and a scanned page is just an image, so the mark sits over the scan exactly as it would over regular text. No OCR is involved or needed for watermarking. If you also want the scanned text to become searchable, run the file through the BlendPDF OCR tool before or after watermarking.

fileSizeLimits.question: What are the file size limits?
fileSizeLimits.answer: One PDF per operation, up to 50MB, and up to 20 files per 15 minutes per user. Watermark images must be PNG or JPEG. If your PDF is over 50MB, run it through the Compress PDF tool first.

compareWatermarkingWord.question: How does this compare to watermarking in Word or Adobe Acrobat?
compareWatermarkingWord.answer: Word can only watermark documents it can open and edit, and re-exporting a PDF through Word often changes the layout. Acrobat Pro has powerful watermark options but requires a paid subscription. BlendPDF works on any existing PDF without touching its layout, is free, and needs no installation or account.

errorWatermarking.question: What should I do if I get an error while watermarking?
errorWatermarking.answer: The most common errors: a watermark image that is not PNG/JPEG, a file over 50MB, or a "too many requests" message (wait a few minutes; the limit is 20 files per 15 minutes). If a valid file still fails, it may be corrupted — try the Repair PDF tool first.

restrictions.question: Can I remove PDF restrictions without a password?
restrictions.answer: Yes, if a PDF only has printing, copying, or editing restrictions (owner password), our tool can remove them instantly without requiring you to enter the password.

restrictionsVsPassword.question: What's the difference between restrictions and password protection?
restrictionsVsPassword.answer: Restrictions (owner password) prevent you from printing, copying text, or editing the document, but still allow you to open it. Password protection (user/open password) encrypts the entire file and prevents you from even opening it without the password.

legal.question: Is it legal to remove PDF restrictions?
legal.answer: Yes, it is legal to remove restrictions from PDFs that you own, created, or have the legal right to modify. Do not use this tool on copyrighted materials you do not have rights to.

whatRestrictions.question: What restrictions can be removed?
whatRestrictions.answer: Our tool removes printing locks, text/image copying restrictions, document assembly locks, and form filling restrictions.

howItWorks.question: How does PDF unlocking work?
howItWorks.answer: We use the password you provide to decrypt the PDF. The password is required to unlock the file. Once unlocked, the PDF can be opened without a password.

forgotPassword.question: What if I forgot the password?
forgotPassword.answer: Unfortunately, if you don't know the password, we cannot unlock the PDF. The encryption is designed to be secure, so the password is required. Make sure you have the correct password before attempting to unlock.

security.question: Is it safe to unlock PDFs here?
security.answer: Yes. Your files are processed securely and never stored — Files are deleted from our servers within 1 hour — most immediately after processing. We never keep your PDFs or passwords.

notEncrypted.question: What if my PDF is not password-protected?
notEncrypted.answer: If your PDF is not encrypted, you don't need to unlock it. Simply open it normally. This tool is only for PDFs that require a password to open.

unlockPdfOnline.question: How do I unlock a PDF online?
unlockPdfOnline.answer: Upload the PDF and choose a mode. "Remove Restrictions" strips printing, copying, and editing locks without a password. "Unlock with Password" removes an open password, but you must enter the correct password. Download the unlocked copy when processing finishes.

blendpdfRecoverCrack.question: Can BlendPDF recover or crack a forgotten PDF password?
blendpdfRecoverCrack.answer: No. If a PDF requires a password to open and you do not know it, BlendPDF cannot unlock it. Modern PDF encryption is designed so the password is mathematically required. No honest online tool can bypass it.

legalUnlockPdf.question: Is it legal to unlock a PDF?
legalUnlockPdf.answer: It is generally lawful to unlock documents you own, created, or have the right to modify, such as your own files or documents shared with you for editing. Do not use it to bypass protection on copyrighted material or documents you have no rights to; laws vary by country.

safeUnlockPdf.question: Is it safe to unlock a PDF online?
safeUnlockPdf.answer: Yes. Files and passwords travel over encrypted HTTPS, the password is used once for decryption and never stored, and files are deleted from our servers within one hour, most immediately after processing. Document contents are never read, stored, or shared; we only collect aggregate anonymous usage analytics.

unlockingPdfsFree.question: Is unlocking PDFs free, and do I need an account?
unlockingPdfsFree.answer: Yes, it is completely free with no watermark and no hidden paywall, and no account or email is required. An optional email-delivery feature exists, but direct download never asks for an email.

whichEncryptionTypes.question: Which encryption types are supported?
whichEncryptionTypes.answer: BlendPDF handles standard PDF encryption as defined in the PDF specification, from older 40-bit and 128-bit RC4 files up to modern AES-128 and AES-256. Non-standard DRM systems (like Adobe LiveCycle rights management) are not supported.

fileSizeLimits.question: What are the file size limits?
fileSizeLimits.answer: One PDF per operation, up to 50MB. Larger files should be compressed first, though a password-protected file must be unlocked before other tools can process it.

unlockingChangeDocument.question: Will unlocking change my document?
unlockingChangeDocument.answer: No. Unlocking decrypts the file and removes the security settings; the pages themselves are not re-rendered. Text, images, fonts, layout, links, and form fields are unchanged, and your original file on your device is untouched.

sayPasswordIncorrect.question: Why does it say my password is incorrect?
sayPasswordIncorrect.answer: Passwords are case-sensitive and must match exactly, including spaces and special characters. Check for Caps Lock, keyboard layout differences, and copy-paste that includes a trailing space. If the correct password truly fails, the file may use non-standard protection.

sayPdfAlready.question: Why does it say the PDF already has no restrictions?
sayPdfAlready.answer: The file is not encrypted and has no permission locks, so there is nothing to remove. If an app still blocks copying or printing, the limitation comes from the app or from the PDF being a scanned image, not from PDF security.

unlockPdfTools.question: Why do I need to unlock a PDF before using other tools?
unlockPdfTools.answer: Encrypted PDFs cannot be read by processing tools, so merge, compress, sign, and conversion tools fail on them. Unlock the file first, run the tool you need, then re-protect the result with the Protect PDF tool if you want a password back on it.

blendpdfCompareAdobe.question: How does BlendPDF compare to Adobe Acrobat or print-to-PDF workarounds?
blendpdfCompareAdobe.answer: Acrobat Pro can remove security but requires a paid subscription and the password. Printing to a new PDF sometimes bypasses restrictions but destroys text quality, links, and structure. BlendPDF removes security properly, keeps the document intact, and is free.

howItWorks.question: How does PDF to Excel conversion work?
howItWorks.answer: We use advanced table detection algorithms to identify tables in your PDF, extract the data, and convert it to Excel format. Multiple tables are saved to separate sheets in the Excel file.

tableDetection.question: What if my PDF doesn't have tables?
tableDetection.answer: If your PDF doesn't contain extractable table data, the conversion will fail with an error message. This tool is specifically designed for PDFs that contain tabular data.

multipleTables.question: What happens if my PDF has multiple tables?
multipleTables.answer: If your PDF contains multiple tables, each table will be extracted and saved to a separate sheet in the Excel file. The sheets will be named 'Table_1', 'Table_2', etc.

formatting.question: Will the formatting be preserved?
formatting.answer: We extract the data and structure of tables. Basic formatting like cell alignment and borders may be preserved, but complex formatting may be simplified in the Excel output.

convertPdfExcel.question: How to convert PDF to Excel online
convertPdfExcel.answer: Upload your PDF by clicking "Choose file" or dragging it onto the upload area, click "Convert to Excel", and download the resulting XLSX file. The tool scans every page for tables, extracts the data, and builds a spreadsheet. No account or email is required.

tableExtraction.question: How does the table extraction work?
tableExtraction.answer: BlendPDF analyzes the text layer of your PDF to detect table structures on every page, then rebuilds the rows and columns as real spreadsheet cells. It extracts data and structure, not visual styling, so you get an editable spreadsheet rather than a picture of a table.

pdfExcelConverter.question: Is the PDF to Excel converter free?
pdfExcelConverter.answer: Yes. No watermark, no row or page limits designed to upsell you, no sign-up, and no subscription. The practical limits are technical: 50MB per file and about 20 conversions per 15 minutes.

safeUploadFinancial.question: Is it safe to upload financial documents?
safeUploadFinancial.answer: Files are uploaded over an encrypted connection, document contents are never read, stored, or shared, and files are deleted from our servers within one hour, most immediately after processing. No account is needed. We use Google Analytics for aggregate, anonymous usage measurement only.

tablesFoundError.question: Why do I get a "No tables found" error?
tablesFoundError.answer: The tool needs an actual table structure in the PDF's text layer. You will see this error if the PDF is a scan with no text layer (run it through the BlendPDF OCR tool first), if the data is laid out as plain text rather than a table, or if the file contains only images of tables.

convertScannedPdf.question: Can I convert a scanned PDF to Excel?
convertScannedPdf.answer: Not directly. The converter reads the PDF's text layer, so tables that exist only as scanned images cannot be extracted. Run the PDF through the BlendPDF OCR tool first to add a text layer, then convert it here.

formattingColorsFormulas.question: Will formatting, colors, and formulas be preserved?
formattingColorsFormulas.answer: No, and no converter can preserve formulas, because PDFs only store the calculated values, never the formulas behind them. You get the data and table structure. Cell colors, borders, and fonts are not carried over; add formatting and formulas in Excel afterward.

accurateExtraction.question: How accurate is the extraction?
accurateExtraction.answer: Clean, grid-like tables extract very reliably. Tables with merged cells, multi-line headers, nested sub-tables, or values that span columns can come out misaligned and need a few minutes of cleanup. Always spot-check totals against the original PDF.

fileSizeLimits.question: What are the file size limits?
fileSizeLimits.answer: One PDF at a time, up to 50MB, with all pages scanned for tables. Processing is capped at about two minutes, so extremely long documents may time out; split them first and convert in parts.

convertPasswordProtected.question: Can I convert password-protected PDFs?
convertPasswordProtected.answer: Not directly. If you have the password and the right to use the document, remove the protection with the BlendPDF unlock tool first, then convert the unlocked file.

arabicRtlTables.question: Does it work with Arabic or RTL tables?
arabicRtlTables.answer: Partially, and we would rather be honest about it: right-to-left text is a hard case for table extraction. Arabic column order and text may need manual correction in Excel after conversion. Numeric data usually survives better than the text labels around it.

betterCopyingPasting.question: Is this better than copying and pasting from the PDF?
betterCopyingPasting.answer: For anything bigger than a few cells, yes. Copy-paste from a PDF typically collapses a table into one column or one long line, losing the structure. The converter preserves rows and columns and handles all pages at once.

checkConverting.question: What should I check after converting?
checkConverting.answer: Three quick checks: that numbers imported as numbers rather than text (look for left-aligned numerals), that no header rows slipped into the data, and that each expected table has its own sheet. Excel's "Convert to Number" and "Text to Columns" fix most import quirks in seconds.

whyLocal.description: Signing happens entirely in your browser. Your PDF and your signature are never uploaded to a server — everything is processed locally on your own device.

howItWorks.question: How does PDF signing work?
howItWorks.answer: Draw, type, or upload a signature, then drag it exactly where you want it on the page — you can place as many signatures as you need across different pages. The signatures are embedded directly into the PDF, and everything runs in your browser: the file is never uploaded.

textVsImage.question: How can I create my signature?
textVsImage.answer: Three ways: draw it with your mouse or finger, type your name and pick a signature style, or upload an image of your handwritten signature. A PNG with a transparent background looks best, but any common image format works.

legal.question: Is this a legally binding signature?
legal.answer: This tool adds a visual signature to your PDF. For legally binding electronic signatures, you may need specialized services that provide digital certificates and audit trails. This is a simple signature overlay tool.

multiplePages.question: Can I sign multiple pages?
multiplePages.answer: Yes. Use the page navigation to move through the document and place signatures on any pages you like — you can add several signatures and apply them all in one go.

signPdfOnline.question: How do I sign a PDF online?
signPdfOnline.answer: Upload your PDF (up to 50MB), then draw, type, or upload a signature and drag it exactly where you want it on the page — you can place several signatures across different pages. Click apply and download the signed copy. Everything runs in your browser and no account is required.

digitalSignatureVisual.question: Is this a digital signature or a visual signature?
digitalSignatureVisual.answer: A visual signature. BlendPDF draws your name or signature image onto the page. It is not a cryptographic (PKI) digital signature: there is no certificate, no tamper-evident seal, and PDF viewers will not show a signature-validation panel.

differenceBetweenText.question: What is the difference between text and image signatures?
differenceBetweenText.answer: You can create a signature three ways: draw it with your mouse or finger, type your name in a signature font, or upload an image of your handwritten signature. Typed signatures are fastest; drawn and image signatures look handwritten. A PNG with a transparent background looks best.

goodSignatureImage.question: How do I make a good signature image?
goodSignatureImage.answer: Sign with a dark pen on white paper, photograph or scan it in good light, and crop tightly around the signature. A PNG with a transparent background looks best because the page shows through; a JPEG will carry a white rectangle behind the ink.

positionSignature.question: Where can I position the signature?
positionSignature.answer: Anywhere. The signature appears on a live preview of the page and you drag it to the exact spot you want; a corner handle resizes it. Bottom-right is the classic signature spot, but placement is completely free, so you can land it precisely on a form's signature line.

signOnePage.question: Can I sign more than one page?
signOnePage.answer: Yes, in a single pass. Navigate between pages in the preview, place a signature on every page that needs one, and apply them all at once. Each signature can be positioned and sized independently.

signArabicNon.question: Can I sign in Arabic or other non-Latin scripts?
signArabicNon.answer: Yes. Type your name in Arabic, Hebrew, Chinese, or any other script and it renders correctly — your browser shapes the text with proper letter joining and right-to-left direction before it is placed on the page. For a handwritten look in any script, an image signature works too.

signingPdfsFree.question: Is signing PDFs free? Is there a watermark?
signingPdfsFree.answer: Yes, completely free, with no watermark, no signature limit, and no trial-then-paywall. No account or email is required; downloads are direct, with an optional email-delivery feature if you want one.

safeSignDocuments.question: Is it safe to sign documents online?
safeSignDocuments.answer: Yes. Signing happens entirely in your browser — your PDF and your signature are never uploaded to a server, so nothing needs to be deleted afterward because nothing ever leaves your device. We only collect aggregate anonymous usage analytics.

signPasswordProtected.question: Can I sign a password-protected PDF?
signPasswordProtected.answer: No, encrypted PDFs cannot be processed. Remove the password first with the Unlock PDF tool (you need the password), sign the unlocked copy, and re-protect it afterward with the Protect PDF tool if needed.

signScannedPdf.question: Can I sign a scanned PDF?
signScannedPdf.answer: Yes. The signature is drawn on top of the page, so it works on scanned documents exactly as on digital ones. This is the classic use case: someone emails you a scanned form, you sign it and send it back without printing.

fileLimits.question: What are the file limits?
fileLimits.answer: One PDF up to 50MB per operation. Signature images can be any common format your browser can display — they are converted automatically. There is no page-count limit, and you can place signatures on any pages in the document.

comparePrintingScanning.question: How does this compare to printing and scanning, or Adobe Fill & Sign?
comparePrintingScanning.answer: Versus print-sign-scan: same visual result, no printer, and the document keeps its quality and selectable text. Versus Adobe Fill & Sign: similar simple e-signature, but BlendPDF runs in the browser with no app or Adobe account. For certificate-based digital signatures, a dedicated service is the right tool.

signingFails.question: What should I do if signing fails?
signingFails.answer: Check that the PDF is under 50MB and not password protected — encrypted files must be unlocked first with the Unlock PDF tool. Corrupted files can be run through the Repair PDF tool first, though repair cannot fix everything.

howItWorks.question: How does PDF repair work?
howItWorks.answer: We use PDF repair algorithms to attempt to fix corruption issues. The tool tries to recover readable pages and data from the corrupted PDF, creating a new repaired version.

whatCanBeRepaired.question: What types of corruption can be repaired?
whatCanBeRepaired.answer: We can attempt to repair PDFs with structural corruption, missing or damaged page data, and some formatting issues. Severely corrupted files may not be fully recoverable.

guarantee.question: Can you guarantee the PDF will be repaired?
guarantee.answer: While we do our best to repair corrupted PDFs, not all types of corruption can be fixed. The success depends on the extent and type of damage. We'll recover what we can, but some data loss may occur.

dataLoss.question: Will I lose any data during repair?
dataLoss.answer: In some cases, severely corrupted pages may not be recoverable and will be skipped. We'll preserve all pages that can be successfully recovered. The repaired PDF may have fewer pages than the original if some pages were too damaged.

kindsPdfDamage.question: What kinds of PDF damage can be repaired?
kindsPdfDamage.answer: The tool handles structural damage best: broken cross-reference tables, damaged object references, malformed trailers, files that were not closed properly during saving, and PDFs that some viewers refuse to open even though most of the data is intact. It recovers what is still present in the file — it cannot reconstruct data that is missing.

kindsDamageCannot.question: What kinds of damage cannot be repaired?
kindsDamageCannot.answer: If the underlying data is gone, no tool can bring it back. Files truncated during download, files whose bytes were overwritten, encrypted files where the encryption data itself is damaged, and files that were never valid PDFs to begin with usually cannot be recovered. Repair restores structure around surviving content; it does not recreate lost content.

pdfGuaranteedFixed.question: Is my PDF guaranteed to be fixed?
pdfGuaranteedFixed.answer: No, and any tool that promises a 100% success rate is overselling. Success depends on how much of the original data survived. BlendPDF recovers everything it can and returns a rebuilt file, but severely damaged files may come back incomplete or may fail to repair at all.

losePagesContent.question: Will I lose pages or content during repair?
losePagesContent.answer: Possibly. If individual pages are too damaged to read, the fallback recovery skips them and keeps the rest, so the repaired PDF may have fewer pages than the original. When the primary qpdf repair succeeds, all pages are usually preserved. Always open the repaired file and check it against what you expected.

repairCorruptedPdf.question: How do I repair a corrupted PDF online?
repairCorruptedPdf.answer: Upload the damaged PDF (up to 50MB) by dragging it onto the page or clicking Choose File, then click Repair PDF. Processing usually takes a few seconds to a couple of minutes depending on file size. When it finishes, download the repaired copy. No account or email is required.

repairingPdfFree.question: Is repairing a PDF free? Is there a watermark?
repairingPdfFree.answer: Yes, it is completely free. There is no watermark on the output, no page limit, no daily quota that pushes you to a paid plan, and no sign-up. The repaired file is your document, rebuilt — nothing is added to it.

safeUploadCorrupted.question: Is it safe to upload a corrupted PDF?
safeUploadCorrupted.answer: Yes. Files travel over an encrypted HTTPS connection and are deleted from our servers within one hour, most immediately after processing. We never read, store, or share the contents of your documents, and no account is needed. We use Google Analytics for aggregate, anonymous usage measurement only — never your document contents.

fileSizeLimits.question: What are the file size limits?
fileSizeLimits.answer: One PDF per operation, up to 50MB. Repair is limited to 20 files per 15 minutes per user. Corrupted files sometimes cannot be compressed first, so if your file is over 50MB, try recovering it from its original source instead.

pdfsCorruptedFirst.question: Why do PDFs get corrupted in the first place?
pdfsCorruptedFirst.answer: Common causes are interrupted downloads or uploads, emailing a file that gets cut off, crashes while an application is saving, failing storage drives or USB sticks, and software that writes non-standard PDF structures. If a file keeps arriving corrupted, re-export it from the source application rather than repairing each copy.

repairPasswordProtected.question: Can you repair a password-protected PDF?
repairPasswordProtected.answer: Not directly. If the file opens with a password but misbehaves, remove the password first with the Unlock PDF tool, then repair the unlocked copy. If the encryption data itself is corrupted, the file usually cannot be recovered, because the contents are unreadable without intact encryption structures.

repairScannedPdfs.question: Does repair work on scanned PDFs? Do you do OCR?
repairScannedPdfs.answer: Repair works on scanned PDFs the same way it works on any PDF: it recovers the file structure and the page images inside it. It does not perform OCR, so a scanned PDF stays a set of images and its text will not become selectable or searchable after repair. Run the repaired file through the BlendPDF OCR tool if you need its text to become searchable.

repairedFileOpen.question: The repaired file still will not open. What now?
repairedFileOpen.answer: Try re-downloading or re-exporting the file from its original source, check email or cloud storage for an earlier intact copy, look for previous versions in your backup or file-history tools, or ask the sender to resend it. If several independent tools cannot open the file, the data is most likely gone.

compareRepairingAdobe.question: How does this compare to repairing in Adobe Acrobat?
compareRepairingAdobe.answer: Adobe Acrobat quietly rebuilds mildly damaged files when it opens them, but it has no dedicated repair button and requires a paid license for editing features. BlendPDF gives you an explicit repair step, is free, and runs in the browser with nothing to install. For severe corruption, neither approach can recover data that no longer exists in the file.

errorRepairing.question: What should I do if I get an error while repairing?
errorRepairing.answer: Check that the file is under 50MB and actually a PDF — renaming a .docx to .pdf does not make it one. If you see a "too many requests" message, wait a few minutes; the limit is 20 files per 15 minutes. If a repair fails outright, the file is likely damaged beyond what automated recovery can do.

undo.question: Can I undo the deletion?

passwordProtected.question: Does it work with password-protected PDFs?

deletePdfPages.question: How to delete PDF pages online

visualPageSelection.question: How does visual page selection work?
visualPageSelection.answer: After uploading, you see thumbnail previews of all pages. Click on thumbnails to mark pages for deletion - selected pages show a red border, red overlay, and checkmark. Click again to unmark. A selection counter shows how many pages will be deleted.

selectMultiplePages.question: Can I select multiple pages at once?
selectMultiplePages.answer: Yes, you can click on multiple thumbnails to select them individually, or use "Select All" to select all pages at once, then deselect the ones you want to keep. At least one page must remain in the document.

deletingPagesPreserve.question: Does deleting pages preserve PDF quality?
deletingPagesPreserve.answer: Yes, deleting pages preserves all PDF quality for the remaining pages including formatting, images, text, fonts, and interactive elements. The quality of remaining pages is unchanged.

pageDeletionArabic.question: Does page deletion work with Arabic PDFs?
pageDeletionArabic.answer: Yes, BlendPDF works perfectly with Arabic PDFs and all RTL languages. Text direction, character order, and formatting are all preserved correctly for remaining pages.

fileSizeLimits.question: What are the file size limits?
fileSizeLimits.answer: You can upload PDF files up to 50MB in size. There's no limit on the number of pages you can delete. Very large documents may take slightly longer to process.

pageDeletion.question: How long does page deletion take?
pageDeletion.answer: Page deletion typically takes 5-10 seconds, depending on the number of pages and file complexity. The process is fast and efficient, with your new PDF ready for download almost immediately.

originalFileModified.question: Is my original file modified?
originalFileModified.answer: No, your original file is never modified. BlendPDF creates a new PDF with selected pages removed while leaving your original file completely untouched on your device.

deletePagesMobile.question: Can I delete pages on mobile devices?
deletePagesMobile.answer: Yes, BlendPDF works seamlessly on smartphones and tablets. The visual page selection interface is touch-friendly and works perfectly on mobile devices.

deletingPdfPages.question: Is deleting PDF pages free?
deletingPdfPages.answer: Yes, deleting PDF pages with BlendPDF is completely free — no fees, no watermarks, and no premium tiers today. All features are available at no charge.

filesDeletion.question: What happens to my files after deletion?
filesDeletion.answer: All uploaded files are automatically deleted from our servers within one hour, most immediately after processing. We never read, store, or share the contents of your documents. No permanent storage is maintained.

pageDeletionFails.question: What if page deletion fails or produces errors?
pageDeletionFails.answer: Common issues include file size limits, corrupted PDFs, or network problems. Try refreshing and retrying. Verify your file opens correctly in a PDF viewer and check your internet connection.

arrangement.question: How are images arranged in the PDF?
arrangement.answer: Images appear in the PDF in the order shown in the grid. You can drag and drop to rearrange them before converting.

quality.question: Will image quality be preserved?
quality.answer: Images are embedded at high quality, and photo orientation is corrected automatically. You can choose between A4 pages (image scaled to fit, aspect ratio preserved) or pages sized exactly to each image.

convertImagesPdf.question: How to convert images to PDF online
convertImagesPdf.answer: Upload your images (JPG, PNG, or WEBP), drag and drop thumbnails to reorder them, remove unwanted images if needed, then click "Convert to PDF". Each image becomes a page. The process takes 5-15 seconds.

convertMultipleImages.question: Can I convert multiple images at once?
convertMultipleImages.answer: Yes, you can upload multiple images at once. Simply select all the images you want to include from your device. Each image will become a separate page in the final PDF document.

reorderImagesConverting.question: Can I reorder images before converting?
reorderImagesConverting.answer: Yes, you can drag and drop image thumbnails to rearrange them in any order. The order of thumbnails determines the order of pages in the final PDF. You can also remove images using the X button.

pageSizePdf.question: What page size is used for the PDF?
pageSizePdf.answer: Images are fitted to A4-sized pages while maintaining their aspect ratio. Images are centered on each page. This standard size ensures compatibility with most PDF viewers and printers.

imagesPositionedPage.question: How are images positioned on the page?
imagesPositionedPage.answer: Images are centered on A4 pages and scaled to fit while maintaining aspect ratio. This ensures images display correctly without distortion, regardless of their original dimensions.

fileSizeLimits.question: What are the file size limits?
fileSizeLimits.answer: You can upload multiple images, with each image up to 50MB in size. There's no limit on the number of images you can convert at once, though very large batches may take longer to process.

imagesConvertOnce.question: How many images can I convert at once?
imagesConvertOnce.answer: You can convert any number of images at once. There's no limit on the number of images you can include in a single PDF conversion. Each image becomes one page in the PDF.

conversion.question: How long does conversion take?
conversion.answer: Conversion typically takes 5-15 seconds, depending on the number and size of images. The process is fast and efficient, with your PDF ready for download almost immediately.

convertImagesMobile.question: Can I convert images on mobile devices?
convertImagesMobile.answer: Yes, BlendPDF works seamlessly on smartphones and tablets. You can upload images from your device storage, photo library, or cloud storage. The interface is mobile-optimized and touch-friendly.

arabicRtlText.question: Does it work with Arabic or RTL text in images?
arabicRtlText.answer: Yes, if your images contain Arabic or other RTL text, that text will be preserved in the PDF. The images themselves are converted as-is, maintaining all content including text in any language.

convertingImagesPdf.question: Is converting images to PDF free?
convertingImagesPdf.answer: Yes, converting images to PDF with BlendPDF is completely free — no fees, no watermarks, and no premium tiers today. All features are available at no charge.

imagesConversion.question: What happens to my images after conversion?
imagesConversion.answer: All uploaded images are automatically deleted from our servers within one hour, most immediately after processing. We never view, analyze, or share your images. No permanent storage is maintained.

conversionFailsProduces.question: What if conversion fails or produces errors?
conversionFailsProduces.answer: Common issues include unsupported formats, file size limits, or network problems. Ensure images are in JPG, PNG, or WEBP format. Try refreshing and retrying if errors occur.

convertPdfPages.question: How to convert PDF pages to images online
convertPdfPages.answer: Upload your PDF, choose JPG or PNG, and click convert. Every page is rendered as a separate 300 DPI image. You can preview each page, download individual images, or grab all of them at once as a ZIP file. No account or email is required.

chooseJpgPng.question: Should I choose JPG or PNG?
chooseJpgPng.answer: PNG is lossless and best for pages with text, line art, or diagrams, where crisp edges matter. JPG produces smaller files and works well for photo-heavy pages. If you are unsure, PNG for documents, JPG for photos.

resolutionQuality.question: What resolution and quality do I get?
resolutionQuality.answer: Pages are rendered at a true 300 DPI, meaning an A4 page becomes an image of roughly 2480 x 3508 pixels. That is print-quality resolution, and JPG output uses a high quality setting of 95 to keep compression artifacts minimal.

pdfImagesConverter.question: Is the PDF to images converter free, without a watermark?
pdfImagesConverter.answer: Yes. No watermark on any image, no per-page fees, no sign-up, and no paid tier. The technical limits are 50MB per file and 100 pages per conversion.

safeConvertPdf.question: Is it safe to convert my PDF online?
safeConvertPdf.answer: Files are uploaded over an encrypted connection, document contents are never read, stored, or shared, and files are deleted from our servers within one hour, most immediately after processing. receiveImages.question: How do I receive the images?
receiveImages.answer: All pages arrive in a single ZIP file with zero-padded names like page-001.jpg so they sort in the correct order. You can also preview every page in the browser and download any single page individually without downloading the whole ZIP.

convertOnlySpecific.question: Can I convert only specific pages?
convertOnlySpecific.answer: Not directly; the tool converts every page. To convert a subset, first extract the pages you want using the BlendPDF split or delete-pages tool, then convert the smaller PDF. That also keeps the ZIP small.

arabicRtlPdfs.question: Does it work with Arabic and RTL PDFs?
arabicRtlPdfs.answer: Yes, very well. Rendering to an image is a faithful visual snapshot of each page, so Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, and Urdu text appears exactly as it does in the PDF, with no text reconstruction involved and nothing to reflow or misorder.

scannedPdfsConvert.question: Will scanned PDFs convert properly?
scannedPdfsConvert.answer: Yes. A scanned PDF is already images inside a PDF wrapper, so conversion simply exports each page. Output quality mirrors the original scan; rendering at 300 DPI cannot add detail that the scanner did not capture.

searchCopyText.question: Can I search or copy text from the images?
searchCopyText.answer: No. JPG and PNG files contain pixels only, with no text layer, so the images are not searchable and text cannot be selected. If you need editable text, use the BlendPDF PDF to Word tool on a text-based PDF; for scans, run the BlendPDF OCR tool first to add a text layer.

convertPasswordProtected.question: Can I convert a password-protected PDF to images?
convertPasswordProtected.answer: No. Encrypted PDFs cannot be rendered. If you have the password and the right to use the document, remove the protection with the BlendPDF unlock tool first, then convert.

screenshots.question: Why not just take screenshots?
screenshots.answer: Screenshots are capped at your screen resolution, typically 100-150 DPI of effective detail, and capturing a long document page by page is slow and error-prone. This tool renders every page at a true 300 DPI in one pass, with consistent sizing and correct ordering.

conversionFailsZip.answer: Check the file is a valid, unencrypted PDF under 50MB and 100 pages. For a smaller ZIP, choose JPG instead of PNG. blendpdfSPdf.answer: Yes. There is no watermark on the output, no page limit, no daily quota that pushes you to a paid plan, and no sign-up. The only practical limits are technical ones: 50MB per file and a processing window of about two minutes.

accountEmailAddress.question: Do I need an account or email address to download my file?
accountEmailAddress.answer: No. You can convert and download without creating an account or entering an email. An optional email-delivery feature exists if you would rather receive the file in your inbox, but you can always skip it and download directly.

safeConvertPdf.question: Is it safe to convert my PDF online?
safeConvertPdf.answer: Uploads are encrypted in transit, document contents are never read, stored, or shared, and files are deleted from our servers within one hour, most immediately after processing. No account is needed. We use Google Analytics for aggregate, anonymous usage measurement only.

accurateConversion.question: How accurate is the conversion?
accurateConversion.answer: BlendPDF uses the pdf2docx engine, which reconstructs paragraphs, tables, and images from text-based PDFs with good fidelity. Simple, single-column documents convert very well. Complex multi-column layouts, heavy graphic design, and right-to-left text may need manual cleanup after conversion.

formattingImagesTables.question: Will formatting, images, and tables be preserved?
formattingImagesTables.answer: Text, images, and most tables carry over. Fonts are matched as closely as possible, and paragraph structure is rebuilt so the document is genuinely editable. Elements that commonly shift are text boxes, footnotes, multi-column sections, and decorative layouts.

convertScannedPdf.question: Can I convert a scanned PDF to Word?
convertScannedPdf.answer: Not into editable text directly. The converter reads the PDF's text layer, so a scanned page is an image and no words can be extracted from it; the output would contain the page images rather than editable text. Run the file through the BlendPDF OCR tool first to add a text layer, then convert.

arabicRtlPdfs.question: Does it work with Arabic and other RTL PDFs?
arabicRtlPdfs.answer: You can convert them, but right-to-left text is one of the hardest cases for any PDF-to-Word engine, including ours. Expect the text to come through, with word order, joining, or alignment sometimes needing cleanup in Word. Simple Arabic documents fare much better than complex layouts.

convertPasswordProtected.question: Can I convert a password-protected PDF?
convertPasswordProtected.answer: No. Encrypted PDFs cannot be processed directly. If you have the password and the right to modify the document, use the BlendPDF unlock tool to remove the protection first, then convert the unlocked file.

formatOpenAnywhere.question: What format do I get, and can I open it anywhere?
formatOpenAnywhere.answer: You get a DOCX file, the standard Microsoft Word format. It opens in Word, Google Docs, LibreOffice, and Pages. If you need the older DOC format, open the DOCX in any of those apps and save it as DOC.

blendpdfCompareWord.question: How does BlendPDF compare to Word or Adobe Acrobat?
blendpdfCompareWord.answer: Microsoft Word can open PDFs directly and Adobe Acrobat Pro has a strong exporter, but Word's results vary and Acrobat requires a paid license. BlendPDF is free, works in the browser with no install, and handles text-based documents well. For extremely complex layouts, Acrobat Pro may still do better.

convertedFileLook.question: Why does my converted file look different from the PDF?
convertedFileLook.answer: The most common causes are fonts that were not embedded in the PDF (substituted fonts change line breaks), multi-column or designed layouts, and scanned pages, which convert as images unless you add a text layer with the BlendPDF OCR tool first. Small spacing differences are normal and quick to fix in Word.

conversionFailsError.question: What if the conversion fails or I get an error?
conversionFailsError.answer: Check that the file is a valid, unencrypted PDF under 50MB. If the PDF is damaged, run it through the BlendPDF repair tool first. A "too many requests" message means you hit the limit of about 10 conversions per 15 minutes; wait a few minutes and try again.

quality.question: Will formatting be preserved?
quality.answer: We preserve formatting, images, tables, and layout as faithfully as possible. Documents that use uncommon fonts may see minor font substitutions — embedding fonts in your Word file gives the closest match.

layout.question: Will the layout stay the same?
layout.answer: The PDF closely matches your document's layout, margins, headers, footers, and page breaks. Very complex layouts or uncommon fonts may shift slightly.

fileSize.question: What are the file size limits?
fileSize.answer: You can convert Word documents up to 50MB in size. There's no limit on the number of pages, but larger files may take longer to process.

privacy.question: Is my document secure?
privacy.answer: Yes. Your files are processed securely and never stored — Files are deleted from our servers within 1 hour — most immediately after processing. We never read or share your documents.

cost.question: Is this really free?
cost.answer: Yes, completely free! No sign-up, no credit card, no hidden fees. Convert as many Word documents to PDF as you need.

convertWordPdf.question: How to convert Word to PDF online
convertWordPdf.answer: Upload your Word document by clicking the select button or dragging it onto the upload area, click "Convert to PDF", and download the result. Conversion takes seconds for typical documents. No account or email is required, and there is no watermark.

whichFileFormats.question: Which file formats are supported?
whichFileFormats.answer: Microsoft Word .doc and .docx, OpenDocument .odt, and Rich Text Format .rtf. All of them convert to a standard PDF that opens anywhere. Files can be up to 50MB.

wordPdfConverter.question: Is the Word to PDF converter really free?
wordPdfConverter.answer: Yes. No watermark on the PDF, no page limits, no conversion quota that pushes you to a paid plan, and no sign-up. The technical limits are 50MB per file and about 10 conversions per 15 minutes.

safeUploadDocument.question: Is it safe to upload my document?
safeUploadDocument.answer: Files are uploaded over an encrypted connection, document contents are never read, stored, or shared, and files are deleted from our servers within one hour, most immediately after processing. No account is needed. We use Google Analytics for aggregate, anonymous usage measurement only.

pdfLookSlightly.question: Why does my PDF look slightly different from the Word file?
pdfLookSlightly.answer: Almost always fonts. If your document uses a font that is not available on the conversion server, a similar font is substituted, which can shift line breaks and page breaks. Using widely available fonts, or checking the PDF before sharing it, avoids surprises.

hyperlinksTablesContents.question: Are hyperlinks, tables of contents, and page numbers kept?
hyperlinksTablesContents.answer: Yes for the common cases: hyperlinks remain clickable, page numbers and headers and footers are rendered, and a generated table of contents converts as it appeared when the file was last saved. Dynamic fields are rendered at their last-updated values.

arabicWordDocuments.question: Does it work with Arabic Word documents?
arabicWordDocuments.answer: Yes. The LibreOffice engine has mature right-to-left support, so Arabic text direction, alignment, and letter joining convert correctly. The main caveat is fonts: if your Arabic font is not available on the server, a substitute is used, which can slightly change the look.

convertPasswordProtected.question: Can I convert a password-protected Word document?
convertPasswordProtected.answer: No. A password-protected Word file cannot be opened by the converter. Remove the password in Word first (File > Info > Protect Document), convert it here, and then, if you want protection back, use the BlendPDF protect tool to encrypt the PDF with AES-256.

passwordProtectPdf.question: How do I password-protect the PDF I create?
passwordProtectPdf.answer: Convert your document first, then run the result through the BlendPDF protect tool, which applies real AES-256 encryption with a password you choose. Together the two tools take under a minute.

editPdfAfterward.question: Can I edit the PDF afterward, or convert it back to Word?
editPdfAfterward.answer: PDFs are not meant for heavy editing, so keep your original Word file as the master copy. If you no longer have it, the BlendPDF PDF to Word tool converts the PDF back to an editable DOCX, faithfully for typical documents though not always identically.

insteadWordS.question: Why use this instead of Word's built-in Save as PDF?
insteadWordS.answer: If you have desktop Word, its built-in PDF export is excellent and you should feel free to use it. BlendPDF is for everyone else: no Word license, working on a phone or a locked-down computer, converting .odt or .rtf files, or needing a quick conversion without opening an editor.

checkConverting.question: What should I check before and after converting?
checkConverting.answer: Before: accept or reject tracked changes and delete stray comments, since the PDF renders the document as it would print. After: skim the PDF for font substitutions or shifted page breaks. If something fails, check the file opens in a word processor and is under 50MB.

removesContent.question: Does cropping remove content or reduce the file size?
removesContent.answer: No. Cropping hides, not deletes — it sets the page's crop box, so content outside the selection is hidden from view but still stored in the file. That's also why cropping doesn't reduce the file size. If you need a smaller file, try our Compress PDF tool.

undo.question: Can I undo a crop?
undo.answer: Yes. Because cropping only hides content instead of deleting it, the crop is reversible — the hidden content can be restored later by resetting the crop box (for example by cropping again with a larger area, or with any PDF editor). Your original file also stays untouched on your device.

allPages.question: Can I crop all pages at once?
allPages.answer: Yes! Choose "All pages" and the same crop area is applied to every page — ideal for trimming uniform margins across the whole document. You can also crop just the current page.

differentSizes.question: What if my pages have different sizes?
differentSizes.answer: When cropping all pages, the selection is applied as the same relative area on each page — for example, the middle 80% — so it scales correctly even when page sizes differ.

privacy.question: Is my PDF uploaded to a server?
privacy.answer: No. This tool runs 100% in your browser — your file is opened and cropped locally on your device and is never uploaded anywhere. It's free and requires no sign-up.

cropPdfPages.question: How to crop PDF pages online
cropPdfPages.answer: Upload your PDF (up to 50MB), drag a rectangle on the page preview to select the area you want to keep, choose whether to apply the crop to all pages or just the current page, then click "Apply Crop & Download". Everything runs in your browser.

cropOnePage.question: Can I crop just one page?
cropOnePage.answer: Yes. Choose "Current page only" and the crop is applied solely to the page you're viewing. Use the page navigation arrows to move to the page you want before applying.

croppingArabicPdfs.question: Does cropping work with Arabic PDFs?
croppingArabicPdfs.answer: Yes. Cropping only adjusts the visible page area, so Arabic text, right-to-left layout, diacritics, and mixed-language content are preserved exactly as they are in the original document.

fileSizeLimits.question: What are the file size limits?
fileSizeLimits.answer: You can open PDF files up to 50MB. There's no limit on the number of pages. Since processing happens on your own device, very large files simply depend on your device's memory and speed.

fastCropping.question: How fast is cropping?
fastCropping.answer: Cropping is nearly instant because there's no upload or download wait — the crop box update happens locally on your device. Speed depends on your device and browser, not on server load, and even large documents typically finish in seconds.

originalFileModified.question: Is my original file modified?
originalFileModified.answer: No. The tool creates a new PDF (named "cropped-" plus your original filename) with the crop applied, while your original file remains completely untouched on your device.

cropPasswordProtected.question: Can I crop password-protected PDFs?
cropPasswordProtected.answer: No, encrypted PDFs can't be opened for cropping. If you have the password and permission, unlock the PDF first with an unlock tool, then crop the unlocked copy.

cropPdfsMobile.question: Can I crop PDFs on mobile devices?
cropPdfsMobile.answer: Yes. The crop interface is touch-friendly — you can drag the crop rectangle with your finger on smartphones and tablets, and processing happens right on your device.

croppingPdfsFree.question: Is cropping PDFs free?
croppingPdfsFree.answer: Yes, cropping PDFs with BlendPDF is completely free — no fees, no watermarks, no account required, and no premium tiers today. All features are available at no charge.

croppingFailsProduces.question: What if cropping fails or produces errors?
croppingFailsProduces.answer: Common causes are files over 50MB, corrupted PDFs, or password-protected files. Verify the file opens in a PDF viewer, check the size, unlock encrypted files first, and try refreshing the page and cropping again.

formulas.question: What happens to formulas?

sheetsWorkbookIncluded.question: Are all sheets in my workbook included?
sheetsWorkbookIncluded.answer: Yes, all sheets in the workbook are included in the PDF. If you only want certain sheets, delete or hide the others in a copy of the file before converting, or split the resulting PDF afterwards.

cellFormattingPreserved.question: Is cell formatting preserved?

convertCsvFiles.question: Can I convert CSV files to PDF?
convertCsvFiles.answer: Yes. CSV files are opened as a spreadsheet on the server and exported to PDF the same way as Excel files. Since CSV carries no formatting, the PDF shows a plain table of the data.

conversion.question: How long does conversion take?

uploadSpreadsheetsGoogle.question: Can I upload spreadsheets from Google Drive?
uploadSpreadsheetsGoogle.answer: Yes, the upload area includes a Google Drive picker so you can select an Excel file stored in your Drive without downloading it to your device first.

originalSpreadsheetModified.question: Is my original spreadsheet modified?

convertExcelPdfMobile.question: Can I convert Excel to PDF on mobile devices?

convertingExcelPdf.question: Is converting Excel to PDF free?

Charts, logos, and diagrams are often vector graphics — drawn with lines and shapes, not stored as images — so there is nothing to extract. Scanned PDFs work the other way: each page is usually one big photo, so you'll get a single full-page image per page. If you want every page saved as a picture regardless, use our PDF to Images tool instead.

formats.question: What format do the extracted images come in?
formats.answer: All images are saved as PNG files, which is lossless — nothing is recompressed, so you keep the full quality that was stored in the PDF. Note that images originally embedded as JPEG are converted to PNG on the way out, so file sizes can be larger than the originals.

inBrowser.question: Is my PDF uploaded to your servers?
inBrowser.answer: No. This tool runs 100% in your browser — your PDF is opened and processed locally on your device and never uploaded anywhere. That's also why it's fast: there's no upload or download wait.

duplicates.question: Why do I see fewer images than the PDF appears to contain?
duplicates.answer: We automatically remove duplicates — a logo or header image that repeats on every page is extracted only once. We also skip tiny images under 16×16 pixels, which are usually invisible artifacts or masks rather than real pictures.

differenceFromPdfToImages.question: How is this different from the PDF to Images tool?
differenceFromPdfToImages.answer: PDF to Images renders each full page as one picture — text, graphics, and all. Extract Images pulls out only the original photos and pictures embedded inside the PDF, at their original stored resolution. Use this tool to recover the actual photos; use PDF to Images to get page snapshots.

extractImagesPdf.question: How to extract images from a PDF online
extractImagesPdf.answer: Upload your PDF (up to 50MB) and BlendPDF automatically scans every page for embedded pictures, showing thumbnails as it goes. Select the images you want and download one directly as PNG or several bundled in a ZIP. Everything runs in your browser.

chooseWhichImages.question: Can I choose which images to download?
chooseWhichImages.answer: Yes. Every found image appears as a selectable thumbnail showing its dimensions and the page it first appears on. Use Select all / Deselect all or toggle images individually — one selected image downloads directly as PNG, multiple download as a ZIP.

pageImageLimits.question: Are there page or image limits?
pageImageLimits.answer: Files up to 50MB are accepted. To keep your browser responsive, scanning covers the first 200 pages and stops after 500 images — you'll see a clear notice if either cap is reached, and splitting the PDF lets you extract the rest.

imageQualityPreserved.question: Is the image quality preserved?
imageQualityPreserved.answer: Yes. Images are extracted at the exact resolution they're stored at inside the PDF and saved as lossless PNG — no scaling, no recompression. A 2000×1500 embedded photo comes out as a 2000×1500 PNG.

arabicPdfs.question: Does it work with Arabic PDFs?
arabicPdfs.answer: Yes. Image extraction reads embedded pictures, which are language-independent — Arabic and RTL documents are scanned exactly like any other PDF, and the fully localized Arabic interface is available too.

fastImageExtraction.question: How fast is image extraction?
fastImageExtraction.answer: The scan runs page by page with a live progress bar, typically finishing in seconds. Speed depends on your device and the document's size, not on server load — there's no upload or download wait.

extractImagesPassword.question: Can I extract images from password-protected PDFs?
extractImagesPassword.answer: No, encrypted PDFs are detected and rejected with a hint to unlock them first. If you have the password and permission, remove the protection with an unlock tool, then extract from the unlocked copy.

extractImagesMobile.question: Can I extract images on mobile devices?
extractImagesMobile.answer: Yes. The thumbnail grid is touch-friendly on phones and tablets — tap to select images, then download a single PNG or a ZIP straight to your device. Processing happens locally on the phone.

extractingImagesFree.question: Is extracting images free?
extractingImagesFree.answer: Yes, completely free — no fees, no watermarks, no account, and no premium tiers today. All features, including the ZIP download and selection controls, are included.

extractionFailsProduces.question: What if extraction fails or produces errors?
extractionFailsProduces.answer: Check that the file is a valid PDF under 50MB and not password-protected. If pages contain only vector graphics you'll get a "no images found" result rather than an error — try the PDF to Images tool instead. Refreshing and retrying resolves most one-off failures.

extractPagesPdf.question: How to extract pages from a PDF online

chooseSinglePdf.question: Should I choose "Single PDF" or "One file per page (ZIP)"?
chooseSinglePdf.answer: Single PDF puts all selected pages into one new document, in order. One file per page saves each selected page as its own single-page PDF and bundles them into a ZIP that downloads immediately — handy when each page goes to a different recipient.

orderExtractedPages.question: What order do the extracted pages come in?
orderExtractedPages.answer: Pages appear in the order your input produces them, with duplicates removed. "1-3, 7" gives pages 1, 2, 3, 7 in sequence. Ranges must run low to high (like 2-6), so extraction follows the document's page order within each range.

extractionArabicPdfs.question: Does extraction work with Arabic PDFs?

fileSizeLimits.question: What are the file size limits?

fastPageExtraction.question: How fast is page extraction?
fastPageExtraction.answer: Usually a few seconds. There's no upload or download wait because everything happens on your device — speed depends on your hardware and how many pages you extract, not on server load.

qualityExtractedPages.question: Is the quality of extracted pages preserved?
qualityExtractedPages.answer: Yes. Pages are copied directly from the source document — text, images, vector graphics, and fonts are carried over without re-rendering or recompression, so extracted pages are identical in quality to the originals.

extractPagesPassword.question: Can I extract pages from password-protected PDFs?

extractPagesMobile.question: Can I extract pages on mobile devices?

extractingPdfPages.question: Is extracting PDF pages free?

extractionFailsRange.question: What if extraction fails or my range is invalid?
